headlines.title: France slips into contraction as Europe’s growth slows: How bad could it get?
headlines.summary: France’s private sector contracted this month, dragging eurozone business activity growth to a four-month low amid political uncertainty and high energy costs.

headlines.title: US sanctions target Iran s rail sector as Tehran shifts cargo from sea routes to overland corridors
headlines.summary: As US sanctions expand to Iran s rail sector, Tehran is relying more heavily on overland links with China and Central Asia. But capacity constraints, delays and costs limit rail s ability to replace maritime trade.

headlines.summary: Increasing amounts of US capital are flowing into Germany s traditional industrial firms and family-owned businesses. As many business owners struggle to find successors, more companies are becoming acquisition targets.

headlines.title: Could lab-made gold crash prices like diamonds? US start-up says it turned mercury into gold
headlines.summary: Little-known San Francisco start-up Marathon Fusion says it has turned mercury into stable gold at ten times the rate of CERN's record, raising a question that has haunted the diamond trade: could lab-made gold one day sink the price of the mined metal?

trend_headline: 프랑스 경기 위축과 볼보 감원 속 유로존 둔화 심화
summary: 프랑스 민간 부문의 경기 침체 진입과 고에너지 비용이 유로존 전반의 성장 모멘텀을 4개월 만의 최저치로 끌어내렸습니다. 이와 함께 볼보 등 주요 제조업체들이 중국 경쟁 심화와 미국 관세 압박으로 대규모 구조조정에 나서며 경기 하방 압력을 높이고 있습니다.
key_points: 프랑스 사상 유례없는 민간 부문 경기 위축으로 유로존 성장 둔화 가속
